name: Zone 2 · Orchard
notes:
West/north-west fruit forest expansion (phase 2, from mid-2027 over the following year). The largest Zone 2: extend the hairpin's contour swales out across this slope.
Water: rain held in extended swales; treated water by sub-surface drip only if it falls inside the approved irrigation area (check first). Bucket-water new trees through the first dry spring (Jul–Sep).
Trees (plant Aug–Nov if watered, Dec–Mar if rain-fed): avocado on the best-drained swale mounds, mango in full sun, white and black sapote, macadamia (rain only, no treated water), more citrus, jaboticaba and grumichama in part shade, mulberry, abiu.
Support layer: pigeon pea and cassava as nurse and chop-and-drop, comfrey and vetiver on the swale banks, sweet potato and pinto peanut as ground cover.
Sequence: dig swales in the dry (Jun–Aug 2027), sow pioneers at first storms, plant trees into the pioneer shelter.
Plan: Bright Tree planting calendar and phasing (Oct 2026).
